evidence.snippet: Soldiers grimly dig into frontline barricades, unleashing relentless gunfire into the relentless storm of monsters.
Raising his blunt weapon, Paran stares down the lurkers, telling them to attack all at once.
Tae raises his weapon against the titan, praying their fragile sanctuary doesn't become their tomb.
The burly veteran steps in with disgust, snatching the sledgehammer before anyone gets bit.
When the whiny coward complains again, the burly veteran smacks some sense into him.
Instead of quieting down, the desperate mob hollers even louder, begging for leftover rations.
Staring down at her hollow eyes, the weight of total societal collapse hits hard.

evidence.snippet: Until they reach military lines, securing their own perimeter remains life or death.
He winds up his arm to fling the weighted cords toward a training pole.
Elite operators push forward into the gloom with clinical military precision.
A mounted minigun opens up, chewing through street-level infected with surgical fury.
Asking to be left behind in a zombie outbreak is basically signing your own death warrant.
The lieutenant pushes forward, knowing Tae is holding back an ocean of teeth alone.
Each automated platform literally carries fifty kilos of high-grade plastic explosives disguised as armor.
He gently wraps the deceased elder's bloodied face in a floral blanket for burial.
He looks down at her sudden intervention with cold, calculating suspicion.
Seeing someone fight through hordes only to get exiled over petty pride felt wrong.
